correctness.rationale: For any commutative base k-algebra R, commuting idempotents project to Boolean label coordinates in (A/J)⊗R. Polynomial joint spectral projectors p_alpha produce an orthogonal idempotent system reducing to d_alpha. The conjugator w=Σ p_alpha d_alpha is a unit (1 modulo nilpotent J); decomposition J=H_alpha+N_alpha by equal/cross labels gives unique normalization w=(1+x)(1+h) with x=n(1+h)^{-1}. Both inverses are polynomial, so each labeled functor fiber is truly affine scheme A^{dim N}, not just a bijection of k-points, and reducedness/smoothness hold in all characteristics. Cut dimension κ and Fortuin–Kasteleyn expansion then yield exact point counts, weighted max-cut/chromatic cutoff, and truncated-quiver polynomial recovery. Independently computed ordered commuting idempotents in upper triangular 2x2 over F2,F3 and genuine F4 (counts for m=1,2: (6,28),(8,40),(10,52)); these and inspected 31-case source checker are corroborative only.
